The method / Research the market / Step 3
ACTION 07 OF 32 · PHASE 02

Audit the actual local competition

Understand what customers can really buy in your launch market today.

WHEN TO DO THISBefore deciding you have a unique business.ESTIMATED WORK TIME45–90 min
↗
Your one job

Understand what customers can really buy in your launch market today.

01

Do this now

  1. 01

    Search Google, Maps, social profiles and real marketplace listings for local services/products.

  2. 02

    Log at least five alternatives when available, including offline providers and doing nothing.

  3. 03

    Compare service promise, booking speed, reviews, trust evidence, location, costs and perceived weaknesses.

  4. 04

    Contact potential customers to confirm whether your supposed gap matters.

02

Copy this into ChatGPT

Replace anything in [square brackets] with your real business details. The prompt is a shortcut, not a substitute for the steps above.

READY-TO-USE PROMPT
I am launching [BUSINESS] in [ISLAND/CITY]. Build a live local competitor research table with real source URLs and dates checked. Include direct rivals, substitutes, customer reviews or complaints where verifiable, pricing where public, distribution and opportunities. Do not invent ratings or reviews. End with 5 targeted customer interview questions to test whether my proposed gap matters.
03

Finish with this

Local competitor sheet with source/date, offer, weakness and an honest differentiation hypothesis.

Before moving on, check your work against the following:

  • At least three actual alternatives are reviewed when the market has them
  • Sources and dates are saved
  • Customer validation is planned rather than assumed
DON’T MAKE THIS MISTAKE

Declaring yourself 'number one' or 'first' without evidence.

READY TO MOVE ON?

At least three relevant alternatives are documented; there's a plausible customer gap and a way to test it.
